item.title: fix(cli): keep gateway calls and diagnostics read-only (#125178)
item.summary: fix(cli): keep gateway calls and diagnostics read-only (#125178) * fix(cli): keep gateway diagnostics read-only Direct gateway calls and diagnostic probes now preserve shared SQLite ownership instead of creating or mutating state during read-only operations. Related: #101290 Follow-up to #125102 * fix(cli): keep required status probes read-only
